testcase.name: Scenario: Handle a missing customization import file: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:326:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Handle a missing customization import file ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog is open with no pending changes ✔ And the customization import file picker is open ✔ When the user enters a path to a nonexistent XML file and clicks "Open" ✔ Then a warning says the file was not found and asks the user to check its name ✔ When the user acknowledges the warning ✔ Then the import file picker remains open with the filename selected ✔ When the user cancels the file picker ✔ Then the customization dialog remains open without a pending-change marker ✔ And "Apply" is unavailable
